# Da'vinci Solutions

> AI-powered enterprise automation for small and medium enterprises.

Da'vinci Solutions builds sovereign, GDPR-compliant AI systems that help businesses automate operations through conversational intelligence and persistent memory.

## Products

- [TARA](https://www.davinciai.eu/): Conversational AI voice agent for customer interactions, scheduling, and business automation. Supports multilingual conversations with natural language understanding.
- [HIVEMIND](https://hivemind.davinciai.eu/): Enterprise memory engine with graph-based knowledge storage, semantic recall, and cross-agent memory sharing. GDPR and DPDP compliant. Capabilities: graph-based memory storage, semantic recall across sessions, cross-agent memory sharing, MCP integration for AI assistants.

The platform supports 31 languages and multilingual conversations.

## Capabilities

- Graph-based memory storage — entities, relationships, and knowledge graphs persisted across sessions.
- Semantic recall — retrieve relevant memories by meaning, not keywords.
- Cross-agent memory sharing — multiple AI agents share a common memory cortex.
- MCP integration — expose memory to any MCP-compatible AI assistant (Claude, etc.).
- Sovereign, GDPR/DPDP-compliant data residency — data stays in compliant EU infrastructure.

## FAQ

### What is HIVEMIND?
HIVEMIND is a sovereign, GDPR-compliant enterprise memory engine that gives AI agents persistent, graph-based long-term memory with semantic recall and cross-agent memory sharing, built by Da'vinci Solutions for small and medium European enterprises.

### What is TARA?
TARA is a conversational AI voice agent from Da'vinci Solutions that handles customer interactions, appointment scheduling, and support with multilingual natural language understanding.

### Is Da'vinci Solutions GDPR compliant?
Yes. Da'vinci Solutions builds sovereign AI systems that are GDPR and DPDP compliant, with data residency for European businesses.
